# pstack skills

Installed from the Cursor plugins [`pstack`](https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack) plugin at commit `d457567332aa6989e753ea289f30ea2bfbc80bc0` (plugin version `0.15.28`).

The 56 directories from its `skills/` tree, including bundled references and scripts, are installed in this workspace's `.github/skills/` for VS Code and GitHub Copilot. This imports skills only; Cursor-specific agents, automations, and plugin metadata are not included. Bundled scripts and dependencies have not been run or installed.

The upstream pstack plugin is MIT-licensed; see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).
